title: The Place to Rest
notes: An intentional, terminal resting arrival at No Return. No Contact battle is implied; the field and the other possible interpretation remain unresolved.

lines.text: The place holds your weight. It is the first thing tonight that has asked for nothing in return.
The line you are listening to gives way to another. Nothing hurries it. There is room for each note to be itself and for the next to arrive.
I thought there would be more time after it.
Perhaps there is a body elsewhere, quiet at last in an ordinary room. Perhaps this is the only room there has ever been. The recorder cannot tell you which.
The sound continues. It does not need you to hold it up. That is not the same as saying you were never part of it.
Your hand opens. The next phrase arrives, and there is no longer any need to count the breaths between its notes.
